full_prompt_en: A square 3D animated-film-style scene shows an adult and a child studying a bright painting inside a crowded studio whose back wall dissolves into a misty blue cityscape. The upper half is cool and spacious, filled with distant towers, domes, and slender spires fading into blue atmospheric haze. On the right wall, pinned sketches, frames, and stacked works make a dense vertical patchwork. In the foreground, jars, brushes, loose tools, and paint materials scatter along both sides of a worn floor, leaving a small open route to the central easel. A black pendant lamp hangs from above and casts a warm cone of light over the large framed picture at the right. The picture glows with many tiny warm colors, contrasting with the blue city beyond. To its left stands a curly-haired adult in a light shirt and darker trousers, seen in side profile with a rounded nose and hands held lightly near the waist. In front of the adult, a smaller curly-haired child sits on a tall stool, wearing a dark teal top and turning toward the painting. The two figures are lit along their faces and hair by the lamp and the illuminated canvas, while their backs remain cooler and darker. The easel legs, stool legs, and scattered brushes create a lively web of narrow lines in the lower half. Soft modeled forms and slightly textured painted surfaces give the characters and studio objects a tangible yet stylized finish. The background architecture remains intentionally hazier than the foreground, so the eye settles on the small group and the bright image. There is no clearly readable text. The overall composition is cozy and imaginative, using a warm pool of working light within a vast blue dreamlike backdrop.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形三维动画电影风格场景呈现一名成人和一个孩子在拥挤画室里研究明亮画作，画室后墙渐渐溶入雾蓝色城市景观。上半部冷而开阔，充满远处塔楼、圆顶和细长尖塔，它们消失在蓝色空气雾气中。右侧墙面上，钉着的草图、画框和堆叠作品构成密集的竖向拼贴。前景的罐子、画笔、散落工具和绘画材料分布在磨旧地面的两侧，中央留下通往画架的小小通道。一盏黑色吊灯从上方垂下，把一束暖光投在右侧的大幅装框图画上。图画以众多细小暖色发亮，对照远处的蓝色城市。其左边站着一名卷发成人，穿浅色上衣和较深长裤，以侧面入镜，圆鼻子和双手轻放在腰间。成人前方，一个更小的卷发孩子坐在高凳上，穿深青色上衣，面向图画。灯和明亮画布照亮两人的脸与头发边缘，背部则保持较冷较暗。画架腿、凳腿和散落画笔在下半部组成生动的窄线网络。柔和塑形与略有肌理的绘画表面，使人物和画室物件具有可触而又风格化的完成度。背景建筑有意比前景更模糊，目光因而停在小小人物组和明亮图像上。没有清楚可读的文字。整体构图温馨而富想象力，在广大的蓝色梦境背景中使用一池暖色工作灯光。
style_prompt_en: The stylized 3D animation treatment combines rounded, readable volumes with painterly surface texture and atmospheric depth. Cool blue and slate tones fill a large distant field, while a localized amber light creates a compact focal pool in the near space. Small warm flecks gather inside that pool; darker edges and foreground objects frame it without making the scene rigid. Forms soften rapidly with distance, allowing intricate far silhouettes to read as mood before detail. Narrow vertical and diagonal marks add lively clutter around a simpler central relationship. Lighting is visibly motivated: a nearby downward source warms selected planes, and a broad cool ambient wash fills the rest. The composition moves from crowded near edges through an open center into a vast hazy backdrop. The overall effect is whimsical, intimate, and cinematic, with contrast between warm activity and cool scale defining the look.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格化三维动画表现把圆润可读的体积、绘画式表面肌理与空气纵深结合。冷蓝和板岩色填满广阔远方，局部琥珀光在近处造出紧凑的焦点亮池。细小暖色光点聚在其中；较暗的边缘和前景物件框住它，却不让场景僵硬。形体随距离迅速柔化，使繁复的远处剪影先被读作气氛，再被读作细节。窄竖线和斜线在较简单的中央关系周围加入活泼的繁杂感。布光具有明确依据：附近向下的光源温暖选中平面，广阔的冷色环境光填满其余部分。构图从拥挤的近处两侧穿过开阔中心，进入广大的雾化背景。整体效果奇妙、亲密且具电影感，暖色活动与冷色尺度的对照定义画面。
theme_en: An adult and child looking at a glowing painting in a cluttered studio
theme_zh: 杂乱画室里一名成人与孩子注视发亮的画作
name: Blue Sky Animation Studio
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
